$$

Then, we substitute $p=-3-2q$ into equation $\color{red}(1)$ and solve for $q$:

$$
\begin{aligned} -6p + 4q + 14 &= 0 \\ -6(-3 - 2q) + 4q + 14 &= 0 \\ 18 + 12q + 4q + 14 &= 0 \\ 32 + 16q &= 0 \\ 16q &= -32 \\ q &= -2 \end{aligned}

$$
q=-2
$$

into equation $\color{red}(1)$, then we can find the value of $p$:

$$
\begin{aligned} -6p + 4q + 14 &= 0 \\ -6p + 4\left(-2\right) + 14 &= 0 \\ -6p - 8 + 14 &= 0 \\ -6p + 6 &= 0 \\ -6p &= -6 \\ p &= 1 \end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the solution to the system of equations is $p=1$ and

$$
q=-2
$$

, which can be written as

$$
\left(1,-2\right)

$\{6p - 4q + 68 = 0; 4p + 4q + 12 = 0$" :question/worked-solution "Sometimes, it's handy to assign a number to each equation in a system, so that we can refer to them more easily:

$$
\{6p - 4q + 68 = 0(1); 4p + 4q + 12 = 0(2)
$$

We will isolate a variable in one of the equations and then substitute it into the other equation. Using equation $\color{blue}(2)$, we can solve for $p$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned} 4p + 4q + 12 &= 0 \\ 4p + 4q &= -12 \\ 4p &= -12 - 4q \\ p &= \dfrac{-12 - 4q}{4} \\ p &= -3 - q \end{aligned}
$$

Then, we substitute $p=-3-q$ into equation $\color{red}(1)$ and solve for $q$:

$$
\begin{aligned} 6p - 4q + 68 &= 0 \\ 6(-3 - q) - 4q + 68 &= 0 \\ -18 - 6q - 4q + 68 &= 0 \\ 50 - 10q &= 0 \\ -10q &= -50 \\ q &= 5 \end{aligned}
$$

If we now substitute

$$
q=5
$$

into equation $\color{red}(1)$, then we can find the value of $p$:

$$
\begin{aligned} 6p - 4q + 68 &= 0 \\ 6p - 4\left(5\right) + 68 &= 0 \\ 6p - 20 + 68 &= 0 \\ 6p + 48 &= 0 \\ 6p &= -48 \\ p &= -8 \end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the solution to the system of equations is $p=-8$ and

$$
q=5
$$

, which can be written as

$$
\left(-8,5\right)

$\{2x + y = -7; 2x - 3y = 13$." :question/worked-solution "Sometimes, it's handy to assign a number to each equation in a system, so that we can refer to them more easily:

$$
\{2x + y + 7 = 0(1); 2x - 3y - 13 = 0(2)
$$

We will isolate a variable in one of the equations and then substitute it into the other equation. Using equation $\color{blue}(1)$, we can solve for $y$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned} y + 2x + 7 &= 0 \\ y + 2x &= -7 \\ y &= -7 - 2x \end{aligned}
$$

Then, we substitute $y=-7-2x$ into equation $\color{red}(2)$ and solve for $x$:

$$
\begin{aligned} -3y + 2x - 13 &= 0 \\ -3(-7 - 2x) + 2x - 13 &= 0 \\ 21 + 6x + 2x - 13 &= 0 \\ 8 + 8x &= 0 \\ 8x &= -8 \\ x &= -1 \end{aligned}
$$

If we now substitute

$$
x=-1
$$

into equation $\color{red}(2)$, then we can find the value of $y$:

$$
\begin{aligned} -3y + 2x - 13 &= 0 \\ -3y + 2\left(-1\right) - 13 &= 0 \\ -3y - 2 - 13 &= 0 \\ -3y - 15 &= 0 \\ -3y &= 15 \\ y &= -5 \end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the solution to the system of equations is $y=-5$ and

$$
x=-1
$$

, which can be written as

$$
\left(-1,-5\right)
$$" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/easy :question/answer-fields ["f40c9b80-4cc9-5cb8-afa4-0371d87b467c"] :db/ensure :question/validate} {:db/id "4d5e58df-d87a-5d3b-8451-91e9e3f1757c" :answer/id #uuid "4d5e58df-d87a-5d3b-8451-91e9e3f1757c" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "7" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "92ad25d7-c40d-5066-bdbf-dd1acaadfdab" :answer/id #uuid "92ad25d7-c40d-5066-bdbf-dd1acaadfdab" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "-15" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "77b69005-e991-580b-b25e-307a1dd218c9" :answer/id #uuid "77b69005-e991-580b-b25e-307a1dd218c9" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "15" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "05d9c1d8-7776-59ee-ab3f-0c7ec5d99ad7" :answer/id #uuid "05d9c1d8-7776-59ee-ab3f-0c7ec5d99ad7" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "-1" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "44ac7e7a-8cd6-5536-adaf-69acb445a0a5" :answer/id #uuid "44ac7e7a-8cd6-5536-adaf-69acb445a0a5" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "-\dfrac{37}{5}" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "64e915ee-d4a5-507a-aa63-39fcbb83ebee" :answer-field/id #uuid "64e915ee-d4a5-507a-aa63-39fcbb83ebee" :answer-field/key "selection" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/radio :answer-field/choices ["4d5e58df-d87a-5d3b-8451-91e9e3f1757c" "92ad25d7-c40d-5066-bdbf-dd1acaadfdab" "77b69005-e991-580b-b25e-307a1dd218c9" "05d9c1d8-7776-59ee-ab3f-0c7ec5d99ad7" "44ac7e7a-8cd6-5536-adaf-69acb445a0a5"] :answer-field/correct "77b69005-e991-580b-b25e-307a1dd218c9" :db/ensure :answer-field/validate} {:db/id "e7e74981-78de-5721-8c70-6b15d18904de" :question/id #uuid "e7e74981-78de-5721-8c70-6b15d18904de" :question/problem "Given the system of equations below, what is the value of $a - b$?

$\{-9x - 9y + 54 = 0; 4x + 8y - 16 = 0$" :question/worked-solution "Sometimes, it's handy to assign a number to each equation in a system, so that we can refer to them more easily:

$$
\{-9x - 9y + 54 = 0(1); 4x + 8y - 16 = 0(2)
$$

We will isolate a variable in one of the equations and then substitute it into the other equation. Using equation $\color{blue}(2)$, we can solve for $x$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned} 4x + 8y - 16 &= 0 \\ 4x + 8y &= 16 \\ 4x &= 16 - 8y \\ x &= \dfrac{16 - 8y}{4} \\ x &= 4 - 2y \end{aligned}
$$

Then, we substitute $x=4-2y$ into equation $\color{red}(1)$ and solve for $y$:

$$
\begin{aligned} -9x - 9y + 54 &= 0 \\ -9(4 - 2y) - 9y + 54 &= 0 \\ -36 + 18y - 9y + 54 &= 0 \\ 18 + 9y &= 0 \\ 9y &= -18 \\ y &= -2 \end{aligned}
$$

If we now substitute

$$
y=-2
$$

into equation $\color{red}(1)$, then we can find the value of $x$:

$$
\begin{aligned} -9x - 9y + 54 &= 0 \\ -9x - 9\left(-2\right) + 54 &= 0 \\ -9x + 18 + 54 &= 0 \\ -9x + 72 &= 0 \\ -9x &= -72 \\ x &= 8 \end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the solution to the system of equations is $x=8$ and

$$
y=-2
$$

, which can be written as

$$
